title: agent-resurrect --json envelope
description: Fields every agent-resurrect --json document carries. stdout holds exactly one such object, newline-terminated and ASCII-only. Within a /1 schema fields are only ever added, never renamed or removed. On success every field of the command's schema is present; on failure the envelope is always present and the other fields are present when known (an argument error carries the envelope only).

ok.description: true exactly when the exit status is 0

code.description: The name of the exit status: 1 error, 2 usage, 3 not-found, 4 needs-tty, 5 busy, 6 gone, 130 interrupted

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC, whole seconds, e.g. 2026-10-12T10:54:16Z; null when unknown

path.description: An absolute path; null when unknown

restore_reason.description: Why automatic restore would or would not resume a record (the restore module's constants)
